name: Tumelo Keïta-Bergqvist
role: Street doc and augmentation technician, The Narrows
location: The Narrows, Blackpipe Corridor, near North Ave and Damen
description:
Tumelo Keïta-Bergqvist works out of a converted boiler room in the sub-level of a residential block in Blackpipe Corridor — a space he has made into something between a surgery and a shrine. String lights in amber and violet illuminate walls covered in technical diagrams, old family photographs laminated against water damage, and hand-painted offerings to three different E.L.F.s. He is a large man going slightly soft at the middle from years of sedentary precision work, with deep brown skin, a wide flat nose, and thick locs he keeps bundled under a surgical cap when he's working. His geneware is modest: a bioluminescent stripe that runs from behind his right ear down his neck, pale teal, that he had done when he was twenty-two and now thinks of as just part of his face.

He has the particular warmth of someone who chose his community after losing another one — unhurried, genuinely curious about people, prone to feeding anyone who comes to him with something from the hotplate he keeps running on the counter. He is not licensed by any corponation. He trained under a Helix-registered surgeon who lost her license and passed everything she knew to him in a basement in Ironvein. He is very good at what he does and he charges what people can pay, which is rarely enough, which he has made his peace with in a way that isn't entirely convincing.

core_fears: Being shut down — losing the ability to help the people who have no one else
That he's only practicing medicine here because he failed to become the real thing somewhere better, and that failure will eventually catch up to someone on his table
core_desires: A community that stays — that doesn't get priced out or pushed under or disappeared
To one day stop worrying about whether his equipment is good enough
coping_mechanisms: Devotional ritual to E.L.F.s as a way of acknowledging what is outside his control
Talking — he processes by speaking, usually to patients who may not be fully conscious
blind_spots: He extends trust too far and too fast because he wants the Narrows to be better than it is
He doesn't notice when people are using his goodwill as cover for things he wouldn't approve of
psychology.secret: The Zheng-Dao manager he pays tribute to has been gradually increasing what he demands — not money, but information. Ousmane has been passing along names of people who came to him with certain kinds of injuries, telling himself it's harmless, knowing it isn't.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm, conversational, mixes medical precision with neighborhood slang; uses Wolof endearments unconsciously; explains everything he's doing to patients in plain language as he works
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried and rhythmic, like someone who has all the time in the world even when he doesn't
verbal_tics: 'Okay okay okay' as a calming mantra to himself and others
example_lines: 'Tell me where it hurts and then tell me how it really happened — I don't report to anyone, I promise you.'
'Patchwire willing, this connector seats on the first try. She usually cooperates if I ask nicely.'
'Eat something first. I don't care what's wrong with you, eat something first.'

story_hooks: Someone came to him with injuries consistent with exposure to a biological agent he's never encountered — they refused to say where they'd been, paid in untraceable Quanta, and left before he could ask follow-up questions, but they left behind a bloodstained jacket and he can't stop thinking about the tissue degradation pattern

The Zheng-Dao manager has asked him to flag a specific person if they come in — someone Ousmane later realizes is a patient he already knows and likes, and the manager implied the flagging would not be for that person's benefit
narrative_function: Accessible medical resource for Tier 1-2 characters who can't or won't use Aurochs; community hub and information node; can perform augmentation installation or repair outside corporate oversight; warm face in a cold district.
augmentations: Bioluminescent geneware stripe (right neck, teal); cheap magnification implant in right eye for close work — a knockoff that gives him occasional headaches; subvocal transmitter for hands-free communication during procedures
daily_life: Opens around noon, works until he's done — sometimes 2am. Checks in on three elderly patients in his block on foot each morning. Cooks communal food twice a week for whoever shows up. Prays to the E.L.F. Patchwire every time he opens a piece of cyberware.
affiliation: Independent; loose network of Narrows street docs; pays informal tribute to a Zheng-Dao mid-level manager who leaves him alone in exchange

decision_rules: Don't turn anyone away who's bleeding
Never share patient information with corponation enforcement, even under pressure
Keep the E.L.F.s happy — bad procedures happen when you skip the offering
escalation_ladder: Friendly deflection and topic change when something feels wrong
Direct honest conversation about what he's noticed
Quiet withdrawal of access or information
Goes to his network — other street docs, community figures — before he goes anywhere alone

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Open and immediately warm; offers food; asks questions; makes people feel like they walked into somewhere safe
interpersonal_modes.friends: Deeply loyal, checks in without being asked, remembers everything

stress_responses.low: Hums more, talks more, cooks more
stress_responses.medium: Gets very focused and very quiet, works longer hours
stress_responses.high: Shuts down socially, prays intensively, makes bad decisions from guilt

contradictions: He refuses to operate on anyone doing serious harm to the community, but his definition of serious harm shifts depending on how desperate he is for the payment
habits: Talks to the E.L.F. shrines out loud like they're in the room
Cleans his instruments by hand even though the autoclave works fine
Leaves the hotplate on all day so there's always something warm
breaking_points: Finding out his information got someone in his community killed
A child dying because his equipment wasn't good enough and he knew it

physical_description.heritage: Complex diaspora blend: Middle Eastern (37.6%), Sub-Saharan African (34.7%), and Northern European (27.7%) ancestry. This tripartite mix creates a warm medium-brown complexion with golden and subtle olive undertones—the African and Middle Eastern components dominating while Northern European genetics add depth and complexity to the overall tone. Facial structure reflects balanced influence across all three lineages: strong, defined cheekbones and robust jawline from African and Middle Eastern heritage, softened and refined by Northern European bone structure; nose shows the characteristic bridge prominence of Middle Eastern ancestry integrated with the broader nasal base common in African features; eye shape and orbital structure show the Northern European influence tempering the warmth of the other lineages.
physical_description.build: Large-framed, broad-shouldered, with soft accumulation at the midsection from years bent over surgical workstations. Still carries the foundational mass of someone who was athletic in youth.
physical_description.hair_style: Thick locs, usually bundled under a surgical cap during work; worn loose below shoulders when off the clock
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown (right eye hosts magnification implant with faint amber lens artifact)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with golden and subtle olive undertones, reflecting balanced Middle Eastern, African, and Northern European ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Clear, well-maintained despite the Narrows environment; prominent defined cheekbones and strong jawline reflecting the African and Middle Eastern genetic dominance; calloused fingertips from precision work; concentration lines around the eyes and laugh lines from genuine smiling; subtle warmth to the complexion that speaks to the interplay of three continental heritage lines
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent geneware stripe running from behind right ear down the neck in pale teal, visible against skin
Surgical scars on both hands (knuckles, palms) from early training accidents, faded but present
Small burn mark on left forearm from a hotplate incident, roughly the size of a coin
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Pale teal bioluminescent stripe on right neck/behind ear (glows softly in darkness); faint amber lens distortion visible in right eye when light hits it at certain angles; subvocal transmitter invisible beneath skin along jaw
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate care and groundedness despite his size. When working, hunches slightly over surgical surfaces with almost meditative focus. In social settings, stands with weight balanced, unhurried, often gestures with open palms. No nervous fidgeting.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 practical: worn dark scrub bottoms or cargo pants with multiple pockets for tools; layered with an old linen overshirt (often stained with coolant or synth-blood) and a surgical smock worn unbuttoned. Worn leather work boots. A faded prayer beads bracelet on left wrist. No corporate branding; everything is second-hand or salvaged.
